name: player_prepare_pending_world_collision_response
description: Player::PreparePendingWorldCollisionResponse prepares world-contact recovery by restoring previous pose, handling airborne upward bounces, rebuilding motion basis, and rotating projectile velocity into local velocity.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player collision/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4248e0 shows the second fastcall argument as the world-contact chain, the airborne positive-Y bounce branch that lowers restored world Y by 0.200000003f per queued contact, the normal previous-pose restoration path with a sub-mode -1.0f Y offset, angular velocity reset, positive-Y projectile damping by -0.800000012f, motion-basis rebuild, and motionBasis row dot products into localVel.
The native smoke checks both the airborne stacked-contact bounce branch and the normal sub-mode restore path with identity orientation.
